user.title: Home Theater
user.description: Name the room and choose its TV and AV receiver. The room becomes one device that turns both on and off, switches sources on both and shows what is playing.

data_description.name: Entity IDs use this name, for example media_player.stue_theater.
data_description.tv: Arrow keys and TV apps go to this TV.
data_description.receiver: Volume goes to the receiver, and its inputs become sources.
data_description.wol_mac: Optional. Lets Home Assistant turn the TV on while it is off the network. Enable Turn on via Wi-Fi (or Mobile TV On) on the TV.

inputs.title: How the TV and receiver connect
inputs.description: Choosing a receiver source puts the TV on the receiver's input. Choosing a TV app puts the receiver on the TV's sound.

data.tv_input: TV input the receiver is connected to
data.tv_audio: Receiver input for the TV's own sound

data_description.tv_input: For example HDMI 2, or the name the TV gives the receiver. The list is empty while the TV is off; you can type the name.
data_description.tv_audio: Usually TV Audio: the input that plays the TV's sound over HDMI ARC.

error.no_devices: Choose a TV, a receiver or both.
error.same_device: Choose a different player for the receiver.
error.invalid_mac: Enter a MAC address such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

init.title: Home Theater settings
init.description: Changes are kept as a draft until you choose Save. Close this dialog to keep the current settings.

sources.title: Favourite sources
sources.description: Choose the sources to offer, in the order you pick them. Leave empty for the receiver's inputs and Live TV. Sources learned while the devices were on stay listed when they are off.

source.title: Name or link a source
source.description: Choose a favourite source to rename, or to link to the player on that input.

link.title: {source}
link.description: Link the player on this input so the room shows what it is playing, and the remote whose arrow keys control it.

data_description.name: For example Apple TV for the receiver's Media Player input.
data_description.player: Such as a Chromecast or Music Assistant player. Its title, artist and picture become the room's.
data_description.remote: Such as an Android TV Remote or Apple TV remote. Without one, arrow keys go to the TV.

error.no_devices: Choose a TV, a receiver or both.

error.invalid_mac: Enter a MAC address such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

unknown_source.message: {source} is not a source in this room.

no_remote_target.message: Nothing to send remote keys to: the TV is off and the source has no remote.

use_receiver.name: Send TV sound to the receiver
use_receiver.description: Switch the TV's sound output back to the receiver over HDMI ARC.
